legend.0: The effect is contained to a small number of customers or to one non-critical feature; core operations, revenue and data are unaffected.
legend.1: A noticeable but partial segment of customers, or one feature many customers rely on, is degraded; there is some effect on revenue or operations, but most customers are unaffected.
legend.2: A core feature is broken or unavailable, or a large share of customers cannot complete what they came to do, with a clear effect on revenue, operations or customer trust.
legend.3: The whole customer base or a core system is affected outright, with severe effect on revenue, data integrity, safety, or legal or regulatory exposure.

legend.0: There is no deadline pressure: the incident can be scheduled into normal work with no special handling.
legend.1: A response is expected within the current work week; nothing described is actively getting worse while it waits.
legend.2: A response is expected within hours: the situation described is actively worsening, or a deadline is close.
legend.3: A response is needed immediately: the situation described is worsening by the minute, or a hard deadline has already passed or is minutes away.
